caption.ja: 固定入力のH₂ RHF：核間距離・s型基底系列・SCF公差を分けて比較。PySCFとの差、反復履歴と有限基底の残る制約を解説。
caption.en: Fixed-input H₂ RHF: separate geometry, s-basis sequence and SCF-tolerance comparisons. Reading states PySCF differences, histories and remaining finite-basis limits.

formula: \mathbf F\mathbf C=\mathbf S\mathbf C\boldsymbol\varepsilon,\qquad \mathbf C^\dagger\mathbf S\mathbf C=\mathbf I

note.ja: 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式で、非局所交換を含む。既存のHe局所還元とH2のRHF例を保持する。追加は固定H2/H3+の最小2電子模型で、UHF式は別の対応模型に明示する。一般多中心分子、開殻の大域安定性、完全基底や一般相関法の保証ではない。
note.en: Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. New calculations cover only fixed minimal two-electron H2/H3+ models; UHF equations have their own mapped model. No general multicenter molecules, global open-shell stability, complete-basis or general correlated-method guarantee.

formula: \hat H_{\rm el}\Psi=E_{\rm el}\Psi,\qquad E_{\rm tot}=E_{\rm el}+\sum_{A<B}\frac{Z_AZ_B}{R_{AB}}

note.ja: 固定核・非相対論の電子固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。従来の水素型動径例を保持し、追加は1次元の箱/HOと3AO以下の2電子FCIに限定する。一般多電子系の直接解法や連続空間の厳密分子解の検証ではない。
note.en: Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic eigenproblems; add nuclear repulsion separately. Preserve the existing hydrogenic radial examples. Additional examples are restricted to one-dimensional box/HO and two-electron FCI in at most3AOs, not general many-electron direct solvers or continuum-exact molecules.

name.en: Unrestricted HF in a minimal two-electron model

note.ja: 2固定距離のみ。有限基底FCIは連続空間の厳密解ではなく、UHF定常解の一般的な大域最小性は保証しません。角運動量・完全基底・広い解離曲線は未検証。
note.en: Only2fixed distances. Finite-basis FCI is not continuum exactness, and UHF stationarity is not a general global-minimum guarantee. Angular/complete-basis convergence and a broad dissociation curve remain untested.

assumptions.ja: H-H距離1.4/3.0bohr、2電子、HごとにSTO-3G縮約s軌道を1個用います。 核間距離1.4/3.0bohr、全エネルギーhartree。各Hに同じ明示3primitiveのs型収縮を1つ置く2AO/2電子の固定部分空間。
assumptions.en: Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function.

note.ja: 2固定距離のみ。有限基底FCIは連続空間の厳密解ではなく、UHF定常解の一般的な大域最小性は保証しません。角運動量・完全基底・広い解離曲線は未検証。
note.en: Only2fixed distances. Finite-basis FCI is not continuum exactness, and UHF stationarity is not a general global-minimum guarantee. Angular/complete-basis convergence and a broad dissociation curve remain untested.

reference_note.en: Use independent RHF references and SCF/s-type-basis checks for a small fixed H₂ model. Agreement in finite-basis RHF is not agreement with a fully correlated exact molecular solution.

method_note.en: Methods explicitly bound to this problem by the common fixed-input execution example. Inspect its input for differences from the figure’s conditions.

name.ja: H₂分子RHF：独立参照・SCF・s型基底拡大
name.en: H₂ molecular RHF: independent reference, SCF and s-basis refinement

scope.ja: 孤立・Born–Oppenheimer・非相対論・2電子閉殻H₂。3核間距離でSTO-3Gと入れ子s型Gaussian基底を比較。RHFの数値検証であり、分子DFT・周期系・完全基底極限や正しい解離を検証しない。
scope.en: Isolated Born–Oppenheimer nonrelativistic two-electron closed-shell H₂. Compare STO-3G and nested s-Gaussian spaces at three separations. Numerical RHF validation, not molecular DFT, periodic, complete-basis or correct-dissociation validation.

assumptions.ja: 固定核・一重項の制限HF、1空間軌道の二重占有。自作Gaussian積分と別実装PySCFで同じ幾何・基底を使用。
assumptions.en: Fixed nuclei, singlet restricted HF, one doubly occupied spatial orbital. Original Gaussian integrals and independent PySCF use identical geometries and bases.

limits.ja: 最大反復・特異な重なり・不適切入力は失敗として扱う。SCF停止と基底公差、物理近似の妥当性を区別する。
limits.en: Iteration limits, singular overlap and invalid inputs fail explicitly. SCF stopping, basis tolerance and physical adequacy remain distinct.

reference_note.ja: 教育用コードをimportしない独立PySCF。同一幾何・同一有限基底のRHFであり、相関を含む厳密解ではありません。
reference_note.en: Independent PySCF imports no educational solver. Same-geometry, same-finite-basis RHF, not an exact correlated solution.

description.ja: 教育用コードをimportしない独立PySCF。同一幾何・同一有限基底のRHFであり、相関を含む厳密解ではありません。
description.en: Independent PySCF imports no educational solver. Same-geometry, same-finite-basis RHF, not an exact correlated solution.

scope.ja: 同じ最小基底H2の2固定幾何で、RHF/UHF/有限基底FCIとスピン対称性を比較します。
scope.en: Compare RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI for H2 at two fixed geometries in the same minimal basis.

assumptions.ja: H-H距離1.4/3.0bohr、2電子、HごとにSTO-3G縮約s軌道を1個用います。 核間距離1.4/3.0bohr、全エネルギーhartree。各Hに同じ明示3primitiveのs型収縮を1つ置く2AO/2電子の固定部分空間。
assumptions.en: Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function.

limits.ja: UHFはスピン混入を持ちます。2幾何だけで完全な解離曲線や連続空間の厳密解を保証しません。
limits.en: Only two H2 geometries and two contracted s orbitals; no complete-basis dissociation curve. UHF is spin contaminated; FCI exactness is finite-basis only.

reference_note.ja: 保存PySCF RHF2値、独立g/u変分多項式・FCI閉形式・fermion組立と照合します。
reference_note.en: Check two saved PySCF RHF energies, an analytic paired g/u variational polynomial, the even2x2 FCI block and independent fermion assembly.
